results.sql: SELECT tag, count(*) AS n FROM sec_fsds_all GROUP BY tag ORDER BY n DESC, tag LIMIT 10

SELECT company, max(value) AS revenue FROM sec_fsds_all WHERE tag IN ('Revenues', 'RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax') AND quarters = 4 AND segments IS NULL GROUP BY company ORDER BY revenue DESC, company LIMIT 10
SELECT count(DISTINCT cik) AS companies, count(DISTINCT tag) AS tags FROM sec_fsds_all

results.query: Numbers and average value per form and unit
results.sql: SELECT form, unit, count(*) AS n, avg(value) AS mean FROM sec_fsds_all GROUP BY form, unit ORDER BY n DESC, form, unit LIMIT 10
SELECT value_date, value FROM sec_fsds_all WHERE ticker = 'NFLX' AND tag = 'Revenues' AND segments IS NULL ORDER BY value_date, value
